position.description: The edge of the screen that the quick terminal comes from, or its centre, where it fades in and out.

size.description: How far it reaches into the screen from its edge, a percentage from 1% to 100% or points, as 300px; then, after a comma, its length along the edge.

screen.description: The screen that it shows on: the main one, the pointer's, or the menu bar's.

animation.description: How long it slides in and out, in milliseconds; 0 shows and hides it at once.

autohide.description: Whether it hides as it loses the focus.

spaces.description: Whether it follows to the Space in front, or stays on the one that it showed on.
